lessons.title: Reading & reproducing papers
lessons.conceptOverview: Separate a paper claim from its assumptions, implementation choices and evidence. Record datasets, preprocessing, architecture, training budget and evaluation protocol. Reproduce a small baseline before scaling the proposed method; missing details should be documented as assumptions.

lessons.title: Ablations & experimental rigor
lessons.conceptOverview: Change one factor at a time when attributing improvements. Use held-out data, multiple seeds and uncertainty estimates. Compare against baselines under similar compute budgets. Negative results can reveal sensitivity or hidden dependencies and should remain in the experiment record.

lessons.title: Research artifacts & evaluation
lessons.conceptOverview: Publish configurations, environment versions, dataset provenance and evaluation scripts with the artifact. Track licenses and privacy constraints. Separate validation used for model selection from the final test set. Report compute, limitations and deviations from the paper alongside results.
